entries.title: Checklist with no hold point
entries.lesson: If a checklist has no hold point, a step can be passed without the check (EVD-0002).
entries.context: The return-to-service index had no checklist entry.

recommendations.what: Add a hold point before acceptance
recommendations.indicator: Share of acceptances with the hold point signed

entries.title: Part number not checked
entries.lesson: If a part number is not checked on issue, the wrong seal can be fitted (EVD-0003).

recommendations.what: Scan the part number on issue
